title: Rect around a centre
prompt: Return a Rect2 of the given size whose middle is at center.
signature: func solve(center: Vector2, size: Vector2) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(center: Vector2, size: Vector2) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(center, size)
hint: The starter puts the corner at the centre. Move the position back by half the size.
solution:
func solve(center: Vector2, size: Vector2) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(center - size / 2, size)
